<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def brush(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color']=='p' and 20<n['pixels']<200 and min(rows)>40:
            return (n['pixels'],min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols))
    return None
def blk(f):
    s={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        bb=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in bb]; cols=[p[1] for p in bb]
        if n['color'] in ('p','O','W') and n['pixels']>20 and 30<min(rows)<45 and 25<min(cols)<40:
            s[n['color']]=n['pixels']
    return s
print("before:", brush(current_frame), blk(current_frame))
action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN:", brush(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
